issue_context.title: Strange CPU usage after some day without reboot (HA virtual machine)
issue_context.body:
### The problem

My HA instance running in KVM virtual machine, VM created with official qcow2 (Home Assistant OS).
Home Assistant 2023.2.3
Supervisor 2023.01.1
Operating System 9.5
Frontend 20230202.0
Database: latest version of MariaDB AddOn, DB size ~1.8Gb

After some (2-3) days without HA reboot I observe a very strange floating CPU load (inside VM):

screens from HA:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32452033/218135977-3b90aa6f-831b-4fef-a526-d8b380b31cf9.png)

Perhaps the problem is somewhere in the database, but I do not have enough knowledge to understand where:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32452033/218136030-cb2ef23e-aa36-4f62-a445-93e992a902bd.png)


from external zabbix:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32452033/218135725-531d4cd8-1e06-4dc7-b653-2e95f1619589.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32452033/218135844-e2cad397-dc27-4cee-adf0-2c137a503be8.png)

After restarting HA (only core) everything goes back to normal for the next couple of days.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32452033/218136644-3eafcc9d-5346-4633-ba7c-a7a9f3b6a610.png)

(I don't understand why, but my previous problem was closed due to unsupported configuration - https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/87831)
